messages:
Ibrahim (Finance): Heads-up: Greenline Health flagged RNL-2027-01 renewal invoice — platform fee line shows as "Platform - Seat" x 12 instead of the negotiated enterprise flat. They expected a single annual platform SKU per SOW.

Zoe (Account Exec): They signed SOW 2026-12-18 for Private + Dedicated with enterprise flat platform $144,000/yr (single SKU PLATFORM_ENTERPRISE_ANNUAL). Renewal preview shows seat pricing. Screenshot: 

Marta (Billing Ops): Invoice preview snippet: ```
Invoice: RNL-2027-01
Customer: Greenline Health
Period: 2027-01-01 - 2027-12-31
Lines:
- DEDICATED_POOL_ANNUAL     Reserved pool (annual)        $360,000
- PLATFORM_SEAT_ANNUAL x12  Platform seat (annual)         $12,000 x12 = $144,000
- SUPPORT_PREMIUM_ANNUAL    Support - premium (annual)     $24,000
Total: $528,000
```

Ibrahim (Finance): The math is right but SKU is wrong. It should be PLATFORM_ENTERPRISE_ANNUAL $144,000 as a single line. This leads to weird downstream analytics and contract matching issues.

Marta (Billing Ops): Root cause: renewal engine selects pricing flavor based on active contract attributes. The customer's contract has both platform seat and enterprise SKUs historically; an old catalog flag "prefer_seats" remained true in the price-mapping job for this customer profile. Renewal pipeline picked seat SKU instead of enterprise.

Zoe (Account Exec): Customer is okay with the dollar total but annoyed about invoice wording and contract mapping (they want enterprise SKU so downstream integration matches). They asked: can we reissue with correct SKU label and ensure future runs use enterprise SKU?

Hannah (Legal): Contract check: SOW lists PLATFORM_ENTERPRISE_ANNUAL. Legal prefers invoice match contract line items. Reissue allowed. No change in amount required. Please ensure reissued invoice references original RNL-2027-01 and notes "formatting correction - SKU label update".

Marta (Billing Ops): Ops plan: 1) Void and reissue RNL-2027-01A with same totals but replace Platform seat lines with single PLATFORM_ENTERPRISE_ANNUAL line; 2) Add internal memo INTCORR-501 to record mapping fix; 3) Patch BF-2210 to clear stale "prefer_seats" flag during contract snapshot normalization. ETA to reissue after approvals: same day.

Ibrahim (Finance): Approve reissue. No credit memo required. Please include billing note: "No change in amount; invoice lines updated to reflect SOW SKU names."

Marta (Billing Ops): billing-bot: creating ticket and branch.

billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-9307 linking RNL-2027-01. Branch billing/fix/prefer-seats-clear-2210 created.

Zoe (Account Exec): I'll tell the customer we'll reissue with corrected SKU labels and share the corrected PDF when ready. Thanks for quick turn. :thumbsup:

Hannah (Legal): Approve wording for invoice note. Add: "This reissued invoice does not modify pricing or terms."

Marta (Billing Ops): Reissue done and emailed. RNL-2027-01A created, references original and includes note. Closing ticket after FP&A reconciliation.

Ibrahim (Finance): Confirm received copy. All good. Closing loop.

Zoe (Account Exec): Customer acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
